primitives.name: Dynamic EWMA Team Strength
primitives.verbatim_quote: Equations & assumptions - EWMA form recursion: **E^B_b(i)(ti) = (1-λ)·E^B_b(i)(t-) + λ·x(t-)**, x = signed game summary (±1 for d=1); Layer-2 analogue **S^B_b(i)(ti) = (1-λ1)·S^B_b(i)(t-) + λ1·O(t-)**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E^B_b(i)': 'Expected blue team strength at time t, dimensionless', 'λ': 'Smoothing parameter, 0 < λ < 1', 'x': 'Signed game outcome (±1), dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Team strength evolves geometrically with exponential decay; features are path-dependent and temporally ordered.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When λ approaches 1, model becomes static; when λ approaches 0, model overfits to recent data.

layer2.mapping: The EWMA captures temporal dynamics of team performance, used as input to a logistic regression for win probability prediction.
layer2.telemetry: Log-loss on holdout set, Brier score for calibration.

primitives.name: Ridge Penalized Team Strength
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Proposed: **pi = expit(β0 + γFP·1[blue first-pick] + βB·E^B_b(i)(ti) - βR·E^R_r(i)(ti) + θ_b(i) - θ_r(i))**; penalized log-loss **-Σ[Oi·log pi + (1-Oi)·log(1-pi)] + τ/2·‖θ‖2**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'π_i': 'Probability of blue team win, [0,1]', 'β0': 'Intercept, dimensionless', 'γ_FP': 'First-pick coefficient, dimensionless', 'θ_b(i)': 'Stable team strength for blue, dimensionless', 'θ_r(i)': 'Stable team strength for red, dimensionless', 'τ': 'Ridge penalty strength, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Team strengths follow Gaussian prior; ridge penalty ensures shrinkage toward zero for unseen teams.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When τ → ∞, all θ → 0; when τ → 0, model becomes unregularized.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a logistic GLMM with random effects θ ~ N(0, σ²θ), where τ ↔ 1/σ²θ.
layer2.telemetry: Log-loss on test set, MAP estimate consistency.

primitives.name: Calibrated Win Probability Model
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Proposed: **pi = expit(β0 + γFP·1[blue first-pick] + βB·E^B_b(i)(ti) - βR·E^R_r(i)(ti) + θ_b(i) - θ_r(i))**; penalized log-loss **-Σ[Oi·log pi + (1-Oi)·log(1-pi)] + τ/2·‖θ‖2**.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'π_i': 'Win probability for blue team, [0,1]', 'expit': 'Logistic function, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Model outputs are naturally calibrated; log-loss ensures proper scoring rule adherence.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core modeling approach combines dynamic EWMA updates for short-term performance and ridge-penalized team strengths for long-term stability. The EWMA recursion defines a time-weighted history of outcomes, while the ridge penalty shrinks team-specific latent variables θ towards a common prior. These components are fused into a logistic regression framework that outputs a calibrated win probability π_i. This architecture allows for both temporal adaptiveness and generalizability across teams. The model is trained using a penalized log-loss objective, ensuring robustness against overfitting. The equivalence to a GLMM with Gaussian random effects provides theoretical grounding for the shrinkage mechanism. Calibration is ensured via native logistic fitting and validated through Brier scores and slope estimates. The two-stage alternative uses a mixed model followed by Platt scaling, but the one-stage formulation achieves comparable performance with better interpretability and reduced leakage risk.
